claim_scores.rationale: Reads the first system message from `lm.history[0]` and asserts it contains `lookup` and `next_tool_name`, matching the ReAct planning prompt with tool catalog and planning outputs.
Reads the second system message from `lm.history[1]` and asserts it omits `lookup` and `next_tool_name` while containing the base task instruction, matching the separate fallback extraction prompt.
Uses `DummyLM` so the first call selects `finish` immediately and the second call returns the answer, producing one planning call followed by one extraction call.
Prints both system prompts and checks the first for planning markers and the second for absence of tool catalog/planning fields plus presence of the original task-only instruction.
